description: Front-line staff work from a decision tree. Anything outside it needs an escalation to a team with no public number.
energy_note: Talking to someone who agrees with you and cannot act.

description: By the third person you are fluent in your own case and the organisation still has no memory of it.
A duplicate charge takes two calls, a webform, a chat session and eleven days. The money comes back. The four hours do not.
A process that is tedious enough causes a predictable share of people to stop, which is cheaper than settling. Giving up is the designed outcome.
'Someone will call you back within 48 hours' has no enforcement mechanism and no record you can point to.
